skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — trim the intro silence, add my name as a lower-third, and export for email...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Video Messages (version 1.0.0)
- Record, edit, and share video messages by describing your desired outcome—no editing software needed
- Supports MP4, MOV, WebM, and AVI files up to 500MB
- Upload your clip, specify edits (like trimming or adding text), and get a shareable video in under a minute
- Automatic session and token setup: free trial available for new users
- Ideal for sales reps, remote workers, and marketers who need quick, polished video messages
